home.metaTitle: Bilingual wedding website, 0 CZK at launch | Se vezmou
home.metaDescription: Create a wedding website in one evening: the schedule, venue, accommodation and guest RSVPs at one address. In Czech and English, 0 CZK during the launch period.
home.ogAlt: Se vezmou: a wedding website for Klára and Matěj with a Confirm attendance button
pricing.metaTitle: Wedding website pricing: 0 CZK during launch | Se vezmou
pricing.metaDescription: How much does a Se vezmou wedding website cost? During the launch period, creating and publishing it costs 0 CZK, and we will announce any later price in advance.
pricing.lead: During the launch period you pay nothing for creating or publishing your website. Publishing will be charged later, and we will announce the price in advance.
templates.metaTitle: Wedding website templates: four styles | Se vezmou
templates.metaDescription: Choose from four wedding website templates, from minimalist to chateau. They are all built on the same blocks and easy to read for older guests.
templates.lead: Editorial, Eucalyptus, Chateau and Modern: four looks built on the same blocks. You pick the look and colours in the wizard and see the preview right away.
bilingual.metaTitle: Bilingual wedding website in Czech and English | Se vezmou
bilingual.metaDescription: A wedding website in Czech and English for guests from abroad: you write the text for each language separately, and guests reply without registering.
bilingual.lead: Guests from abroad find the schedule, venue and RSVP in English. You write each text separately for Czech and for English.
bilingual.points.title: Why a bilingual website
bilingual.points.1.title: English written separately
bilingual.points.1.text: You write the English text yourself, so you can tailor it to your guests instead of offering a mere translation of the Czech.
bilingual.points.2.title: Everything in both languages
bilingual.points.2.text: The schedule, venue, accommodation, dress code and frequently asked questions are in Czech and English, so foreign relatives do not have to guess.
bilingual.points.3.title: RSVP without an account
bilingual.points.3.text: Guests reply right on the website, without registering and without an app.
